implementation: Generic next-step intent with a valid current public goal receives one model-facing natural activity plus legal action label/observation status or current carried-item name. Existing local director and full current name-only catalog remain; no preset reply substitutes for generated prose.

That action discussion narrows shared Runtime/Store context known_evidence/allowed_clue_refs/related_topics to[]; explicit evidence/why-relation questions and active puzzle stages without a valid action goal retain their original references. Model-facing procedural cleanup also handles ordinary next-step requests.

A bounded referential clarification of the last generic action question inherits the current public-action scope only when there is no named object or explicit puzzle/evidence term; history is not new fact. True clock/maintenance format relationship questions retain supporting evidence.

Shared answer validation narrowly exempts only the actually discovered clock clue same original HH:MM value discussed with explicit clock/time prose. Explicit password/answer/input/assembly contexts remain guarded; a separate pure refusal sentence without numbers can coexist with a clock explanation. All other numeric values remain in the whole-solution scan.

Global looks_like_solution and local is_solution_check policies remain unchanged. Internal-vocabulary guard also covers the four new guidance field names; unknown facts/references/completion/credential/whole-answer/360char limits remain.

Runtime rejection trace records only fixed runtime_error/code categories COMPANION_FORMAT, COMPANION_REFERENCE, COMPANION_CONTENT, COMPANION_CONTEXT. Never persist rejected raw prose/question/exception text. Existing provider network errors do not gain content categories. Main separately allows these code values through Store sanitizer.
Strict JSON, json_mode optin, one measured call, max600 output tokens, no tools/proposals/actions/retries, provider/payment/auth/budget and game/save schema behavior unchanged.
